meaning.en: The trunk of the human body.
The trunk of a statue of the nude human figure, esp. of such a statue lacking the head and full limbs.

meaning.en: Any unfinished or fragmentary piece of work.

meaning.en: The human body excluding the head and limbs; trunk.

sentences.en: Of the metopes also a great number of fragments have been found, together with two almost complete metopes, the one containing the torso of a nude warrior in perfect preservation, as well as ten wellpreserved heads.

sentences.en: Besides numerous fragments of nude and draped figures belonging to pedimental statues, a well-preserved and very beautiful head of a female divinity, probably Hera, as well as a draped female torso of excellent workmanship, both belonging to the pediments, have been discovered.
